editorial: Your eyes flicker between the sleek hulk of a soundboard and a vault door as the film blurs the line between sound and lock. The duo of precision piano tuning and safe cracking tools the character wields turns everyday skill into high‑stakes craftsmanship. Joaquin Phoenix, in his sharpest silent turn, delivers a relentless performance that stays in the mind long after the final note. Fans of tense, puzzle‑filled crime dramas will feel the rush of every calculated step. The pacing lulls a few seconds into the third act, but compensates with a tense payoff. You’ll leave the cabin feeling both soothed and shaken.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling.
